items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: I worked out there at Gene Norman's place.

ctx.x: I worked out there at Gene Norman's place. What was the name of it? It was a great big club and it closed and Gene bought it and named it something else.
Well, we'll make a point of that to see if we can't come up with that tomorrow. So you worked out there every so often?
